phases.name: Week 4 · Iterate on the train half

tasks: Upgrade the Anthropic SDK and model IDs
anthropic>=1.7,<2. One settings.py with MODEL_JUDGE=claude-opus-5 and MODEL_EXTRACT=claude-sonnet-5, never hardcoded in call sites. The pinned Sonnet 4 is retired: nothing AI-scored runs today.
Replace the synchronous client inside async routes; iterate content blocks to find the text block (a thinking block may come first).
JSON-schema structured outputs on every model call
additionalProperties:false, levels as enums, no free-text JSON parsing. A failed parse is stored as status=failed, never as a 0 score.
SQLite core tables via SQLModel and import of the 16 demo records

applicants, protected_attributes (audit only), consents, artifacts, rubric_versions, prompt_versions, model_runs, evidence_items, ratings, competency_scores, committee_overrides (append-only), audit_log, users.
Auth: JWT + argon2 + role guards on every router
Roles applicant / interviewer / committee / admin; object-level checks (applicant sees only own record); CORS allowlist; demo account only under DEMO_MODE. Today no scoring endpoint checks auth.
Wrap every applicant artifact in <document> tags; the system prompt states document text is data, never instruction. Quote verification (LED-04) makes injected text unable to become evidence.
Pseudonymous IDs and widened PII regexes on all free-text fields
UUID per applicant; Cyrillic/KZ phone formats (+7 (7xx) xxx-xx-xx, 8 7xx…), 12-digit IIN, emails, handles; apply to essay, written presentation, transcript, project impact, activities.
Batch API, 1-hour cached rubric, cost telemetry
Cohort runs via Message Batches with the rubric as a cached system block; usage, cost and cache-hit rate stored per run.
PII v2: NER redaction, consent records, retention job

Sonnet 5 structured-output NER for KZ/RU/EN names, schools, settlements; legal-representative consent for under-18s (confirm the age rule with inVision counsel); raw video deleted 30 days after decision.
Postgres in-country, backup/restore drill, audit-log export
Only if inVision hosts; Kazakhstan data localization requires the database to sit in the country.
500-applicant synthetic load test through the Batch path
Cost and latency numbers for the pilot slide.
Deletion day: remove every demographic proxy from the score path

Delete SCHOOL_ADVANTAGE, the adversity-keyword decrement, the GPA/academic dimension, the growth delta, length sub-scores and all English keyword banks. Move school type, region, language, Foundation status to protected_attributes.
Drop the 40/60 blend and every 'possibly AI-generated' label from API and UI. Keep at most a neutral 'verify authorship' interviewer hint.
Agree the ledger JSON schema and a fixture on day 1
Per competency: indicator_id, status, quote, source, char span, atola_component, confidence; level enum incl. no_evidence. Both developers and the designer build against the fixture so nobody waits.
Ledger skeleton: two-stage blind pipeline on the two public BARS

Extraction (Sonnet 5, verbatim quotes) → substring verification → BARS rating (Opus 5, verified evidence only, insufficient_evidence enum) → deterministic level → score. Leadership abilities and Wounded leadership first; provisional indicators for the other seven, labeled provisional.
Split the 1,388-line dashboard into views rendered from the fixture
Committee Card, Interviewer Brief, Growth Map, Fairness Audit as separate components.
Nine competencies, 3-level BARS chips, verbatim quotes, indicator ids, 'no evidence' as a distinct state, slot for the contrastive tooltip, override affordance.
Visual system for BARS levels and anchors
Weak / normal / high / no-evidence colors and marks that work in light, dark and print.
ATOLA mapper and water checklist fields
atola_component on each evidence item; missing-component flags drawn from the client's weak anchors; status claimed_only caps a level at Normal. A checklist with quotes, never a deception number.
Contrastive field in the rating schema
'What would move this to the next level' in the anchor's own words; reused by the committee tooltip, the interviewer probe and the candidate feedback.
Indicator ledger plus attention flags with spans; no AI level; spans not persisted beyond the committee session; no trauma prompt anywhere in the form.
Wire the committee card to the real ledger API
Levels, quotes, indicator ids, no-evidence state, contrastive tooltip, Blind/Informed toggle all reading real data.
Demo data seeding and cached results
Every demo click reads from the database; no live model call without a fallback.
Load the full rubric and extend the pipeline to all 9 competencies
rubric_versions with content hash; Talent Craft BARS verbatim; 162-case gold set written with the designer.
Majority level across three samples; disagreement or any insufficient_evidence → unresolved → interviewer probe.
Prompt iteration on the train half; rubric v1.1 if anchors change
Bias-correction-first: estimate per-competency offsets on the labeled set. Never touch the holdout.
Freeze prompts and rubric version; final model card
No changes after the held-out run.
Blind / Informed toggle and Context strip
School, region, language, Foundation shown to humans under 'context — not part of the score'; the toggle re-renders the identical AI score.
It cannot detect bias. Replace with a placeholder for the attribute-grouped audit.
Three states (OK / review / not enough data), the 0.8 review line, CI whiskers, impact-ratio bars, the swap-and-rescore result strip.
Author half of the 36 gold-set cases from the BARS text
Answers at planted levels in three languages, written without seeing the prompts, so the eval isn't authored by the scorer's author.
Evaluation harness v0 with a results page

36 synthetic cases; counterfactual probes (village↔Almaty, public↔private, Kazakh↔trilingual, polished↔imperfect grammar, hardship↔none) with ≤5% level flips; 5-run consistency ≥0.85; injection suite; cross-lingual pairs.

K≈6 single-marker variants re-scored with the identical prompt; tolerance = 2×SD of re-score noise per prompt version; dots on the 3-level strip; flips logged to a red-team log; a 'run with the Stage-1 scorer' comparison.
Impact ratio vs the best group with 1,000-sample bootstrap CI; three states; per language incl. 'mixed' and intersections. Generate ~200 synthetic profiles so CIs are visible on Oct 3.
Write the pre-registration before opening the historical data

Locked preregistration in docs/FAIR-08_PREREGISTRATION.md: hypotheses, fixed metrics and thresholds, synthetic/cached/live/historical modes, registered subgroups, reproducibility manifest, applicant-level 70/30 train/holdout split, and an explicit no-tuning-on-holdout rule.
Ingest the anonymized history and produce the first agreement report
Per-competency QWK/ICC vs committee levels, calibration tables, impact ratios; identify weak competencies (expect 8 and 9).
Model card and fairness pages auto-filled from live data
Intended use, factors, current metrics, evaluation data hash, known limits, where the AI abstains; impact-assessment section on the EU AI Act Art. 27 elements.
Cohort probe suite and fairness gate
Robustness rate per marker × competency on 30–50 sampled candidates; the gate blocks 'publish scorer version' when a probe fails.
Held-out evaluation: the Nov 10 headline numbers
Per-competency kappa/ICC vs committee, impact ratios with CIs, screening-safety check on the lowest band.
Recompute every score from stored ratings; byte-identical.
Impact ratios, calibration statistics, abstention rates for inDrive.
Override ledger: append-only backend plus UI

Override at level or indicator with a mandatory reason code; model composite and committee composite side by side; the original AI row is never overwritten; weights read from the versioned rubric config labeled 'owned by inVision U / Talent Craft'; bands not decimals.
Phone-size and printable: nine evidence states (no number), three ATOLA probes from the client bank, discrepancy alerts, water hotspots, tick boxes, 'do not name the competency aloud' reminder.
Interviewer pre-brief rendered from the ledger
States, probes selected by competency × missing ATOLA component, discrepancy alerts, two verbatim strengths; score withheld. Print and phone views.
Levels, quotes, anchors, test bands, overrides with reasons and authors, probe result, model and prompt hashes, signature lines, 'AI drafted N of M items; committee changed K'.
Print-ready Unicode PDF, KZ/RU localization, persisted LED-11 evidence, and append-only committee signature workflow.
Pre-brief v2 with the real probe bank
Probe selection keyed by competency × missing component from the extended methodology; canonical probe shown next to any paraphrase.
Side-by-side Evidence Compare and triage queues
2–4 candidates × 9 rows, one best quote per cell, BARS anchor in the row header; queues with the deterministic rule that fired; abstention rate as a health metric.
Observe the interview flow with real interviewers
Use the AMA slot; watch how the one-pager is used; adjust.
Only if Talent Craft agrees to review anchor answers per competency × level.
Typed or dictated notes → ledger tuples with one-tap confirm; lists competencies with no notes. No live transcription.
Usability test of brief and card with 2–3 interviewers
Fix anchoring and readability issues before the held-out run.
How to read a card, how to override, what 'unresolved' means, model limits per competency.
Strengths in the candidate's words, 'not yet seen' as opportunity, one zero-budget next step, the re-application door. Kazakh register сіз, Cyrillic.
Growth Map generation with a release gate
Language-neutral plan from the ledger → render in KZ/RU/EN with register lints; released_at NULL until a committee member approves; competency 9 suppressed by default.
Growth Map render plus the objection button
Three-language render; 'this does not reflect me' note attached to the record with a mandatory committee outcome.
Leak guard against the one public test item
n-gram and embedding similarity on all outward text; rewrite or drop, and log the drop.
Candidate-facing tone in three languages, checked with a native speaker
сіз throughout; never mix registers; no level names, no comparisons.
Growth Map content in three languages
Resource lists, next-step phrasing, Foundation pathway; hand to native review.
Native-speaker QA protocol for Kazakh feedback
30 texts, 2 reviewers, naturalness ≥ 4/5, zero register violations.
Leak guard against the full 95-item bank
Embedding plus n-gram similarity; drops logged for the methodology owners.
Written presentation as the canonical input; never score a mock
Form field (150–300 words, any language). Video analysis returns status=no_transcript instead of scoring the hardcoded mock. Pin ElevenLabs Scribe v2 if ASR is used; never Whisper for Kazakh.
Ipsative mock profile, claimed-vs-demonstrated matrix, triangulation radar
Schema and fixture adapter now; the client's bands verbatim; discrepancies become probes, never score changes.
Feynman → Scenario Lab: hardening plus one cached fork

Sessions in DB, auth-bound, attempt-limited; the quiz reads a <lesson> document; re-skin one Teamwork/Values fork; cache a full transcript for the demo; weight fixed at zero; label 'observed in simulation'.
Code-switch-aware language ID and the bias-exclusion manifest
GlotLID document-level plus span-level LID with 'mixed' first-class; Latin-Kazakh transliteration; excluded_features.yaml rendered on the dashboard with a unit test proving none reach a scorer.
Ipsative and interview-note adapters against inVision fixtures
Response-quality flags (incomplete blocks, same-slot pattern, implausibly fast); never re-score or re-band the test.
Dual-ASR evaluation on 10–20 real Kazakh videos
Scribe v2 vs ISSAI Söyle; word-level agreement as displayed confidence; the first WER numbers on spontaneous applicant speech.
Lemma-level stylometry with per-language norms (advisory only)
pymorphy3 for Russian, Stanza/TurkicNLP for Kazakh; drop hapax, word length, filler ratios; percentile shown, never a score input; keep or kill by false-positive rate.
Three-minute narrative in the client's order: before / fairness / inside / committee / after / model card. Every live action has a cached fallback.
The crossed-out 'village = 25 points' slide; the ledger diagram; the three views; the roadmap-not-promised slide.
Freeze and rehearse from cached results
Eval report on the wall; state plainly what is method and what is evidence.
Evidence, not promises: the table of where the model agrees with the committee and where it abstains.
Rehearsals and Final Demo Day, Nov 10
priorities: Evidence Ledger on 9 competencies × 3 BARS levels
Every score decomposes to indicator → verbatim quote; 'no evidence' ≠ 'weak'. Everything else is a view of it.
Remove demographic proxies; Blind/Informed toggle
School type, region, language, income out of every score path; context for humans only.
Interviewer pre-brief (no score)
One page, 9 evidence states, 3 ATOLA probes from the client bank. The 'inside interview' insertion point nobody else builds.
Client-owned weights + append-only override ledger
Composite = Σ weight × level from a signed rubric; bands not decimals; overrides with reasons, never overwriting.
Engineering foundation
SDK, model IDs, structured outputs, DB, auth, PII, injection firewall. The demo is dead without it.
Evaluation harness + pre-registration
36 cases now, history later: kappa vs committee per competency, probes, abstention, impact ratios.
Ipsative test ingestion + claimed-vs-demonstrated matrix
Their bands verbatim; discrepancies → probes, never score changes; never re-scored.
Candidate Leadership Growth Map
KZ/RU/EN, own quotes, 'not yet seen', zero-budget next steps, release gate, competency 9 suppressed.
ATOLA mapper + water checklist
Missing Action/Outcome/Application with quotes; flags → probes; never a deception number.
Two-stage blind pipeline
Extract → verify → rate on verified evidence only; k samples; disagreement → human.
Counterfactual bias probe (swap and rescore)
Noise-calibrated tolerance; cohort suite; fairness gate that blocks publishing a failing scorer.
Real fairness audit by protected attribute
Impact ratios with bootstrap CIs, 0.8 review line, three states, language incl. 'mixed'.
Leadership Scenario Lab (creativity slot, contested)
Feynman transformed into competency-linked forks; unweighted, cached, 'observed in simulation', Talent Craft approves forks.
1/3 · 2 demotes
Wounded / purpose-driven leadership as flags only
Indicator ledger + attention flags; no AI level; no trauma prompt.
Contrastive explanations
'What would move this to the next level' in the anchor's words; one field, three audiences.
Decision Memo + Model Card + Impact Assessment
Reconstructable rejections; EU-AI-Act-style impact assessment; Kazakhstan laws cited.
Kill the AI-text authenticity score
50–100% false positives on non-native writing; no Kazakh calibration; replace with consistency + specificity.
Test-bank leak guard
Every outward sentence checked against the 95 items before it reaches a teenager.
done_note: LED-13 is reopened with its original scope: an earlier edit had renamed it to the COM-06 probe bank and ticked it. Its content-hash part is in (rubric and prompt versions now store sha256 of the rubric and prompt templates, locked in backend/ledger/versions.lock.json, with a CI test that fails on an unbumped change, and the decision memo shows those hashes or 'unregistered'); the Talent Craft BARS verbatim and the 162-case gold set wait for the extended methodology on Oct 5. Until then 7 of 9 scales are drafts (GET /api/ledger/rubric), and COM-06 ships the selection mechanism with a probe bank marked provisional, not approved; its leak guard is CAND-04/CAND-08. LED-11 wires the committee card, interviewer brief, Growth Map and cohort audit to /api/ledger (committee/admin only), which serves stored snapshots, hydrates derived ATOLA fields on load and returns 404 instead of a live rebuild; the frontend fixture copy and its lint check are gone. LED-12 stays open: every demo click now works with no ANTHROPIC/OPENAI/ELEVENLABS key (audit in docs/archive/led-12-demo-click-audit.md). Without a key backend/llm.py refuses every call before a request is built (the .env.example placeholder counts as no key); demo clicks answer 200 from the database, a labelled cache or a deterministic baseline (swap-and-rescore and the evaluation harness say 'deterministic baseline, no model call' and why), live-only endpoints answer 503 'nothing was scored' instead of 500/502, and pages with nothing behind them (model card, funder memo, reproducibility, a candidate without a ledger, cohort ledger health) show 'Unavailable — nothing was scored' without requesting a 404. The c-001 worked example is labelled 'Illustrative worked example — not from this applicant' on the card, brief, Growth Map, memo and PDF, and each of its quotes is tagged, because it was written for a fictional applicant and quotes a written presentation c-001 never submitted; it is not counted as cohort data. `python -m backend.db init` is verified on a clean database (head, 16 applicants, demo login, c-001 example, identical data on a second run); the dev-database 401 was a pre-FND-05 SHA-256 hash on the demo committee row, which init now repairs in place. Remaining, and the reason this is not done: the ledger cache is still empty (0 of 16 applicants), so only c-001 has a ledger and it is illustrative. Re-checked keyless on 2026-09-27 on a copy of the dev database: 445 tests pass including tests/test_no_demographics_in_scoring.py; the whole demo path clicked in the browser gave no 5xx and no console errors; GET /api/fairness/audit?source=db returns 0 applicants with levels and no figures, and cohort ledger health says 'Unavailable — nothing was scored'. The cache build was not run because backend/.env still holds the placeholder key. To close it with a funded key: `python -m backend.ledger.cache --only c-002` (check), then `python -m backend.ledger.cache && python -m backend.db init`, check every quote is verbatim, confirm the c-001 'Illustrative' banner is replaced by 'Cached ledger — built offline', and commit backend/ledger/fixtures/cache/*.json. FND-04, FND-05, LED-05, COM-01, COM-04, FAIR-01, FAIR-02, FAIR-03, FAIR-05, FAIR-06, FAIR-07, FAIR-08, FAIR-09, FAIR-10, FAIR-11, FAIR-12, FAIR-13 and FAIR-14 are shipped. COM-04 adds a committee/admin-only decision memo JSON/PDF with ledger evidence, BARS anchors, test bands, override authors and reasons, probe summary, frozen hashes, signature lines and AI-versus-committee counts. FAIR-14 adds a committee/admin-only funder cohort memo projected from the frozen held-out report, with impact ratios, calibration, abstention rates, frozen provenance, production invariance, backend/API/auth tests and a staff UI. FAIR-08 locks docs/FAIR-08_PREREGISTRATION.md before historical data access: fixed hypotheses, thresholds, data modes, subgroup limits, manifest, and no holdout tuning. FAIR-09 adds anonymized historical ingest, applicant-level 70/30 stratified split, agreement metrics, calibration, bootstrap impact ratios, screening safety and staff-only access without touching production scores. FAIR-10 adds the committee/admin-only model card and fairness page, version hashes, holdout metrics, abstention/no-evidence states, Article 27 impact assessment, and production invariance coverage. FAIR-11 adds a 36-candidate marker × competency robustness suite reusing FAIR-06 swaps and tolerance, explicit live/cached/fallback reports, and a committee/admin scorer-version publish gate that blocks failed probes. FAIR-12 adds a staff-only held-out report endpoint, frozen provenance, per-competency headline metrics, screening safety and explicit production invariance. FAIR-13 adds committee/admin-only replay from saved ratings and frozen hashes, byte-identical report comparison, mismatch diagnostics, explicit replay/live/cached/fallback provenance, production invariance, audit logging, backend/API/auth tests, and a staff UI. LED-09 (contrastive field) and LED-10 (competencies 8 and 9 as flags only) shipped inside LED-04 and are ticked here. LED-08 adds ATOLA coverage, the water checklist and the claimed-only cap. Verified by tests/; FAIR-05 adds the committee/admin-only evaluation harness results page with 36 synthetic cases, cached fallback and reproducible provenance. FAIR-06 adds committee/admin-only swap-and-rescore with cached fallback and noise-calibrated tolerance. Note for the platform side: atola_present and capped_reason are derived, not stored; a loader calls backend.ledger.atola.hydrate once per competency. INP-03 is shipped: Feynman sessions stay in the database, auth-bound and attempt-limited, and the quiz reads the lesson as a document; one Teamwork fork (team-fork, 'The Group Poster') runs on the same mechanism with its own prompts, marked provisional with a content hash because the wording is ours until the Talent Craft methodology arrives; a hand-written demo transcript (backend/data/scenario_demo_transcript.json) is served by GET /api/feynman/demo and shown as 'cached demo transcript' on /teach and the committee card when no model key is set or the model fails; every simulation result carries weight 0 and 'observed in simulation', and tests/test_feynman_scenario.py pins that storing one moves no score or rank. The dashboard card no longer claims weight shifts to the essay; it lists the missing materials. INP-01 is shipped: the written presentation is its own field (Candidate.written_presentation, stored as artifact kind written_presentation; no migration, since kind is a plain string column), required on submission at 150–300 words inclusive in any language, counted by whitespace on the server and in the form (with a live counter), and never a score input; the ledger reads Source.WRITTEN_PRESENTATION from it and no longer from video_transcript, which stays auxiliary and is not a ledger source. No seed applicant had a text that is a written presentation, so the field is empty for all 16 and the committee card says 'no evidence', not weak. MOCK_TRANSCRIPT and the Whisper/OpenAI path are deleted: without a transcript video analysis returns status=no_transcript with no numbers and no model call, without a model key it returns unavailable, and is_mock is gone. ASR is pinned to ElevenLabs Scribe v2 in settings behind ASR_ENABLED plus ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and reports 'ASR unavailable' otherwise; no transcription call is implemented yet, so the §5.21 quote cards and per-word confidence remain Stage 2 work.
